package.title: Chat creation redesign: one-click create + auto-title, empty-chat hint, +AI bot toggle

specification.intent: One-click chat creation replaces the ChatListCreate card form: the list-header «Создать чат» button immediately creates a chat titled «Чат с» (server flag chats.auto_titled, migration 013), the card appears at the top of the list and gets selected so the messenger pane on the right opens with a title input prefilled «Чат с». The server appends each added member's name to the auto title until the user sets their own (manual rename permanently clears the flag — the foundation for future LLM context naming, a declared future step). Chats without messages and co-members show an onboarding hint with an «добавить» button opening the existing add-user modal. A «+AI» button in every chat header enables the bot in THAT chat (is_ai=true via the extended PUT /chats/{id}) and turns active.

requirements.title: Migration 013 + auto_titled in create/list contracts
requirements.description: Additive migration 013_chat_auto_title: chats.auto_titled Boolean NOT NULL server_default '0' (existing chats read false — their titles count as manual); SQLite-safe downgrade. Model Chat.auto_titled. ChatCreate.auto_titled: bool = False and ChatResponse.auto_titled: bool = False (additive; GET /chats passes it field-by-field — the is_dm precedent; model_validate paths fill from the ORM). POST /chats semantics unchanged: always creates, 201, full ChatResponse with id.
requirements.source: operator clarification 2026-11-06 (server-side auto-title flag as the LLM-naming foundation)

requirements.title: POST /chats/{id}/members appends the added member's name to the auto title
requirements.description: ONLY on the FRESH-membership insert branch of add_member (the existing/reactivated-membership early return keeps the title untouched — a repeated add must not duplicate the name; review F-4): when chat.auto_titled AND NOT chat.is_dm — rebuild the title with the added member's name (display_name or email local part — the to_member_brief rule): current title equals the named backend constant AUTO_TITLE_SEED = 'Чат с' (documented to stay in sync with the frontend NEW_CHAT_TITLE — review F-6) → 'Чат с <name>'; otherwise → '<title>, <name>'. Result longer than 200 chars → silent skip (title unchanged, addition still 201). The title update is transactional with the member insert; the SERVICE returns the fact (member, new_title | None) and the WS fan-out lives in the ENDPOINT (repo precedent: every hub.broadcast sits in endpoints, services never import hub — review F-5): on a non-None new_title, ACTIVE members receive the EXISTING WS event chat_renamed {chat_id, title} (no new event type; the frontend already patches the slice title on it).
requirements.source: operator request: «После добавления каждого пользователя в «Чат с» нужно добавлять username»

requirements.title: PUT /chats/{id}: optional title + is_ai, manual rename clears auto_titled, chat_ai_toggled broadcast
requirements.description: ChatUpdate: title becomes optional (1..200, nonblank when present) + is_ai: bool | None = None; model_validator requires at least one field (empty PUT → 422). Guards unchanged (require_active_member: archived 403, non-member 403; anonymous 401). A CHANGED title keeps the existing rename semantics (strip; same-title call is an idempotent 200 no-op WITHOUT a system message and WITHOUT clearing auto_titled; a different title updates, persists the chat_renamed system message) AND sets auto_titled = False — a manual name permanently disables the auto mode. A provided is_ai updates chat.is_ai. The SERVICE returns the facts (chat, system_message | None, ai_changed: bool) and ALL WS fan-out lives in the ENDPOINT (the repo precedent: services never import hub — review F-5): on a system message — message + chat_renamed broadcasts; on ai_changed — the NEW WS event chat_ai_toggled {chat_id, is_ai} to ACTIVE members (no system message). Response: updated ChatResponse (with auto_titled).
requirements.source: operator clarification 2026-11-06 («+AI» enables the bot in the CURRENT chat)

requirements.title: Segment coverage: 013 roundtrip green, 009–012 stay green
requirements.description: New segment roundtrip test for 013 (scratch SQLite: create_all → stamp head → downgrade '012_message_kind' → upgrade head, inspector-asserted both ways). Segment tests 009/010/011/012 stay green; this workstream owns the minimal repin (explicit own-revision stamps) ONLY if an isolation assertion breaks. alembic heads == 013_chat_auto_title.

requirements.title: Remove ChatListCreate; one-click createAndSelect
requirements.description: The ChatListCreate component is deleted entirely (hbs/ts/test, export in components.ts, chat-list-create.scss AND its @import line in src/scss/components/_all.scss — review F-1, the inputs/buttons/refs.create/onAiChatClick wiring in chat.hbs/chat.ts). The existing list-header «Создать чат» button (HeaderIcons onClick — the component itself does not change) calls ChatsController.createAndSelect(): port.createChat({title: 'Чат с', auto_titled: true}) → {chatId} → fetchChats() (card + WS socket) → selectChat(chatId) + getChatUsers(chatId) — select strictly AFTER the list refresh. ChatsPort.createChat changes its return contract to Promise<CreateChatResult> ({chatId: number}; the own adapter maps response.id); ChatInfo.auto_titled?: boolean in utils/types.ts, toChatInfo maps it. NEW_CHAT_TITLE = 'Чат с' constant in utils/constants.ts; AI_CHAT_TITLE is NOT touched — it stays live code of the ai-assistant feature (createAiChat; review F-2), only the ChatListCreate tile usage disappears. Mobile pane: a CDU guard opens chatPaneOpen when selectedChat appears/changes externally (symmetric to the existing undefined-collapse; idempotent setProps).
requirements.source: operator request + clarification 2026-11-06 (instant card + right-pane continuation)

requirements.title: Auto-titled chats render the header title as an immediate input
requirements.description: messenger.ts: when chatInfo.auto_titled === true AND not archived, the header title renders as an <input> IMMEDIATELY (value = title; the existing renamingTitle mechanics — Enter/Escape keydown + focusout commit, focusTitleInput caret) instead of the static h2; non-auto-titled chats keep the h2 + dblclick mode; archived chats never get an input. Commit semantics reuse commitTitleInput: non-empty value differing from the current title → onRenameChat; empty/unchanged → silent revert without a call. ChatsController.renameChat adds auto_titled:false to its EXISTING optimistic title patch (review F-3: the own adapter discards the PUT response and the WS chat_renamed event cannot distinguish a manual rename from the add_member auto-append) — the header turns static immediately on manual commit and the revert-on-error path restores the flag together with the title.
requirements.source: operator request: «инпут для ввода названия предзаполненный «Чат с»» + «если пользователь изначально написал своё название — остаётся без автозаполнения»

requirements.title: Empty-chat onboarding hint with an «добавить» button
requirements.description: messenger.hbs: when messages are empty AND there are no co-members (selectedChatUsers minus meId is empty) AND the chat is not archived AND not is_ai — the feed shows a hint block: text «Добавьте пользователей с помощью кнопки + в верхнем меню, либо нажмите «добавить»» plus a button «добавить» (data-testid=empty-chat-add) opening the existing add-user modal (addUserOpen = true). The block disappears as soon as any gate condition flips (first message, first co-member) without a reload. ChatsController.selectChat clears the chatUsers slice (review F-7: it is not reset between chats today, so a stale list from the previous chat could briefly flip the gate; every selection already calls getChatUsers which repopulates it). Styling in messenger.scss.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-06 + clarification (any chat gated purely by data)

requirements.title: «+AI» header button enables the bot in the current chat
requirements.description: Third headerButtons entry with the public/images/ai-toggle-icon.svg icon (currentColor). Present in every non-archived chat; hidden in archived chats (the visibleHeaderButtons filter alongside cross); an is_ai chat renders it in an active non-clickable state. Click → onEnableAi → ChatsController.enableAi(chatId): port.enableAi(chatId) (PUT /chats/{id} {is_ai: true} + csrf) → optimistic is_ai=true patch in the chats slice with revert on port error. WS: own adapter handles the new chat_ai_toggled event → gateway notifyChatAiToggled → the controller patches is_ai in the slice (other clients update live).
requirements.source: operator request: «Во все чаты наверх добавляем кнопку «+AI» которая добавляет бота в чат и становится активной»

All touched endpoints stay behind get_current_user; anonymous 401 pinned; mutating frontend calls carry readCsrfToken().
No new WS event except chat_ai_toggled; the auto-title append reuses chat_renamed; services/bot.py is not modified (the existing chat.is_ai gate).
src/features/contacts and src/features/ai-assistant are not modified (the DM get-or-create contract and the assistant page stay byte-identical).

Existing suites stay green; counts grow from the recorded base (mocha 696 passing; pytest 291 passed + 4 known Windows ingestion failures documented as environment deviations with full logs retained).
System message content stays server-built and renders through the Message double-brace path (XSS pin); the auto-title pieces flow through the existing escape-then-wrap builders.

disabling the bot from the UI (the button only enables; the PUT contract is symmetric but the UI never sends is_ai=false)
a system message about enabling the bot (chat_ai_toggled is a state patch only)
